integration_fixes: lib.rs: reconstructed the os/main.zig public re-export surface (GetEnvResult, getEnvMap, appendEnv/appendEnvAlways/prependEnv/getenv/setenv/unsetenv, launchedFromDesktop, launchedByDbusActivation, launchedBySystemd, desktopEnvironment, rlimit, fixMaxFiles, restoreMaxFiles, allocTmpDir, freeTmpDir, randomTmpPath, isFlatpak, FlatpakHostCommand[flatpak feat], home, expandHome, ensureLocale, clickInterval, open, OpenType=Kind, pipe, resourcesDir, ResourcesDir, ShellEscapeWriter, getKernelInfo, CFReleaseThread, TempDir) and set PORT STATUS: done.

lib.rs: ported the os/main.zig `test {}` aggregator block as `tests::main_test_refs` (#[test], no assertions — preserves the 1:1 test{} -> #[test] mapping; conditional submodule refs reproduced as cfg! checks).
macos_ns / windows_ns namespaces carry the reference's #![cfg(target_os="macos")] / #![cfg(windows)] gates via the modules' own file-level cfg.

Renamed 7 ported test fns to match the reference name-set (G1 strict name match): shell::shell_command_builder (ref ShellCommandBuilder), homedir::expand_home_unix (ref expandHomeUnix), uri::is_valid_mac_address (ref isValidMacAddress), xdg::parse_terminal_exec (ref parseTerminalExec), hostname::is_valid (ref isValid), file::random_basename (ref randomBasename), mach kept VMTag_make (ref VMTag.make). snake_case forms chosen to avoid colliding with the glob-imported production identifiers of the same name.

Applied cargo fmt across the crate (committed sources were not fmt-clean: flatpak/windows/systemd/uri/pipe/etc.). Only whitespace/wrapping changed; every comment preserved verbatim (G3b still missing=0).

Fixed a parallel-test env race exposed only by `cargo test --workspace` (RUST_TEST_THREADS>1): the Zig reference runs test {} blocks serially, so env-touching tests never observed each other's setenv/unsetenv/HOME mutations. Added a test-only crate-internal shared lock (ENV_TEST_LOCK / env_test_lock()) acquired by the 6 env-touching tests (desktop::desktop_environment, xdg::{config_nonempty,fallback_when_xdg_env_empty,fallback_when_xdg_env_empty_and_subdir}, homedir::{expand_home_unix,home_returns_value}). No reference logic/assertion/comment altered — restores the reference's serial-execution invariant (R1 no-loss glue).
